finding.detail: Ambient observation refused known private windows, but direct screenshots, accessibility reads, continuous vision, the sensory sidecar, and the signed native bridge did not all share that rule. Several paths also omitted the live permissions.screen setting, and an unknown browser title could be treated as permission.
